function: Two DNNs: one at each RIS relay regresses the reflecting-element phase shifts from channel coefficients; one at the destination classifies received signals into QAM symbols (p. 6, 7)
system: Single-antenna source, destination and L=2 half-duplex RIS relays with N=8, 16 or 32 passive reflecting elements; cascaded Nakagami-m links; band not stated (p. 3, 9, 10)
method: Two fully connected DNNs, 4 hidden layers of 256 ReLU neurons, supervised training; regression for relay phases, softmax classification for destination symbols; learning rate 0.003 (p. 7, 9)
data_channel: Simulated cascaded Nakagami-m and Nakagami-m fading with path-loss exponent 4 in MATLAB; 400,000 training samples for the relay DNN, 50,000 for the destination DNN (p. 4, 9, 10)
test_conditions: BER versus SNR for N=8, 16, 32, K=2, 3, m=2, 3 in two scenarios; retraining per setting not stated; perfect CSI assumed (p. 5, 10, 11)
baselines: Non-DNN conventional schemes with RS and MRC combining (classical); relay-only DNN variant (DNN@R) with RS; no earlier published learned method compared (p. 10, 11)
q1_support: p. 4: "the complex channel coefficients can be expressed as the product of statistically independent". Not met: the channels come from a custom cascaded Nakagami-m model with a simple path-loss law; no standardized model or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 6: "the trained DNNs are fed with the real world data to estimate the required parameters during the transmission phase". Not met: the paper never states that a model trained on one setting (N, K, m, channel) is tested on another, and gives no train/test split by scenario.
q3_support: p. 10: "nearly identical with non-DNN or relay-only DNN configurations". Not met: the non-DNN schemes are the classical baseline, but the only learned comparison is the relay-only DNN, a variant of the proposed scheme; no earlier learned method appears in the legends of Figs. 2-3 (p. 10, 11).
q4_support: p. 1: "near-identical performance with low system complexity". Not met: this is a qualitative claim; no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime is reported, and p. 7 gives only the layer sizes.
q5_support: p. 10: "Simulation is realized in the MATLAB environment using the basic training parameters given in Table I". Not met: no code or data link or DOI is given, and the channels are simulated, not taken from a public dataset.
notes: Two learned functions, RIS phase configuration (area 3) and symbol detection (area 1), both scored by BER; by the main-metric rule the area is 1, but the reviewer may prefer 3. The PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint (arXiv:2305.12546v1, p. 1) and carries no DOI, so the match with the DOI rests on the file name. The relay DNN is trained on phase adjustments that maximize the signal at the destination (p. 5, 6). Carrier frequency is not stated. Pages are file pages.
